text: Pointing to a photograph, Vicky said, 'He is the son of the only son of my grandfather.' How is the man in the photograph related to Vicky?
explanation: Grandfather's only son is Vicky's father. The son of Vicky's father is Vicky's brother.

text: Statements: (1) All cups are plates. (2) All plates are spoons. Which of the following conclusions logically follow?

options.text: Only conclusion I follows: All cups are spoons
Only conclusion II follows: Some spoons are plates
Both conclusions I and II follow

explanation: By syllogism: Cups inside Plates, Plates inside Spoons. Therefore, Cups are inside Spoons, and some Spoons are indeed Plates.

text: Five friends sit in a circle facing the center: A is to the immediate left of C. E is to the immediate right of D. B is between C and D. Who are sitting adjacent to E? (Select all correct options)
explanation: Drawing the circle starting clockwise: C -> B -> D -> E -> A. Thus E sits adjacent to A and D.

text: A man walks 6 km South, turns left and walks 4 km, then turns left again and walks 5 km. Which direction is he facing now?
explanation: South -> turn left is East -> turn left is North. Facing North.

text: Find the missing term in the sequence: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?, 56
explanation: Sequence adds consecutive even numbers: +4, +6, +8, +10, so next is +12 => 30 + 12 = 42.
